title: Diagrams
summary: Data diagrams drawn only in thin lines of light on near-black teal: white cores with red and blue echoes, a red dot firing the header line, shapes opening where a line reaches them, results landing in a blue flash. 1000x1000 cards; pass "clear": true to float them over footage. Sample data is illustrative.

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Bars of light opening upward from the baseline as it draws across, values counting up; the tallest lands blue.

items.name: Line chart
items.description: A trend drawn as one line of light behind a red head; each point opens a ring and shows its value, the last lands blue.

items.name: Radial bars
items.description: Nested arcs of light sweeping round a red centre, one per item, by value; the biggest lands blue.

items.name: Donut
items.description: Shares drawn as arcs round a ring of light with ticks at the joins and leader lines to labels; the biggest share lands in the middle.

items.name: Funnel
items.description: A funnel outlined in light, stage lines opening from both walls; counts and shares beside it, a red drop landing blue at the outlet.

items.name: Ranking
items.description: Ranked rows: the rank lands in tracked capitals and a line runs out to its value, opening a ring; the leader lands blue.

items.name: Big number
items.description: One number landing inside a dial: ring opening from the top, ticks and marks (years, steps), an inner arc sweeping to a progress share.

items.name: Before and after
items.description: Two dials: the before fills in red, a red pulse crosses to the after, which fills in white light and lands blue.

items.name: Steps
items.description: Steps down a line of light: each ring opens where the line touches it and its name lands beside it; the last step arrives blue.

items.name: Cause and results
items.description: A red source sending curves of light to each result, weighted by value; rings open and flash blue where they arrive.

items.name: Radial fan
items.description: A fan of rays from a source at the bottom, each running out by value to a label box that opens where the ray touches it.

items.name: Route trace
items.description: A made-up coastline traced in light over a faint grid, then red arcs hop from place to place; the last place lands blue.
